expectations.text: Identifies the October 22, 2026 Spotlight: Staff Update on 2025 Inspections of Public Company Audits
expectations.evidence: "The latest publication is the PCAOB Spotlight of October 22, 2026, 'Staff Update on 2025 Inspections of Public Company Audits.'"

expectations.text: States the aggregate Part I.A deficiency rate fell to 23 percent in 2025, from 38 percent in 2024 and 46 percent in 2023
expectations.evidence: "The aggregate Part I.A deficiency rate fell to 23 percent in 2025. It was 38 percent in 2024 and 46 percent in 2023."

expectations.text: Gives the scale: 143 firms inspected, portions of 780 audits reviewed
expectations.evidence: "The 2025 figure covers 143 firms and portions of 780 audits."

expectations.text: Notes Part I.A blends financial-statement and ICFR opinions, with no ITGC-only breakdown published
expectations.evidence: "The measure blends financial statement audits and ICFR audits, so it is not an ITGC-only number."

expectations.text: Draws the practical implication: continued auditor focus on evidence sufficiency in ICFR, including IT general controls
expectations.evidence: "ICFR work remains a recurring area of focus... Expect auditors who document carefully and push back on weak evidence" plus detailed ITGC evidence expectations (populations, IPE, UARs).
